description: Prioritises positive environmental and social outcomes; accepts moderate financial trade-offs for strong ESG alignment.
literature_sources: Brest & Born (2013); GSIA Global Review (2022); Riedl & Smeets (2017)
real_world_examples: Calvert Impact Capital, Parnassus Core Equity, Generation Investment Management

description: Incorporates ESG as a material risk/opportunity factor alongside conventional financials; seeks risk-adjusted returns with ESG guardrails.
literature_sources: Eccles & Klimenko (2019); PRI Principles (2006); Giese et al. (2019); Khan, Serafeim & Yoon (2016)
real_world_examples: BlackRock ESG Aware ETF, Vanguard ESG U.S. Stock ETF, Nordea ESG STARS

description: Maximises financial performance (returns, Sharpe ratio); uses ESG only as a residual risk screen.
real_world_examples: AQR Capital, Two Sigma, Renaissance Technologies, Dimensional Fund Advisors
